title: pr.json
description: What the PR agent prepared for one wave. migration-control publishes it (branch + PR/MR per repository) only after a human approves.

module.description: Module name from migration.yaml (enum injected at render time).

title.description: Pull request title, e.g. 'Wave 4: Oracle JDBC driver ojdbc6 11.2 -> ojdbc8 23.x'

status.description: READY only if every change is applied and every provable exit gate passed.

patch_file.description: <module>.patch in /mnt/session/outputs/, paths relative to the module root

evidence.description: Quoted real output, or why it was not run

to_run_at_rollout.description: Gates that cannot be proven in a sandbox
